description: 国王印度进攻 A48 — 综合练习：在进攻与简化之间选择兑换时机

intro.popup_en:
Useful Exchanges, Comprehensive Practice 10
This King's Indian Attack position reviews the previous lessons. Before each exchange, ask what it achieves, consider the opponent's best recapture, and decide whether to attack or simplify. Evaluate every exchange actively rather than trading automatically.
intro.popup:
及时兑子 综合练习10

国王印度进攻——白方灵活体系

本局是D14模块的综合练习！

你需要综合运用前9课的知识：
① 兑换前问：为什么要兑，得到什么？
② 分析对方的最佳回吃
③ 判断：进攻还是简化？

⭐ 本节核心：
每次兑换机会，主动分析得失！

outro.popup_en: D14 review: five useful exchange patterns are creating doubled pawns, opening a file through central exchanges, exchanging a good knight for a bad bishop, simplifying symmetrical positions, and using defensive exchanges to interrupt an attack. Before every exchange, ask what structural benefit you gain, what the best recapture is, and whether the timing is right. Exchanges serve strategic goals, not small material gains.
outro.popup:
D14 及时兑子——模块总结

🎓 你已完成10局及时兑子的学习！

5种核心兑换模式：
① 制造叠兵（C68, B30）
② 中心兑换开放列（D35）
③ 好马换坏象（E60，KID）
④ 对称兑换保均衡（C42，彼得罗夫）
⑤ 防守性兑换打断进攻（B23）

3个核心问题（每次兑换前问）：
❓ 这次兑换我得到什么结构好处？
❓ 对方最好怎么回吃？
❓ 现在是最佳时机吗？

记住：及时兑子不是贪小便宜
而是为了更大的战略目标！

moves.popup_en: Nf3 begins White's King's Indian Attack setup.
moves.popup: Nf3 国王印度进攻开始！

moves.popup_en: ...d5 occupies the center.
moves.popup: d5 黑方中心

moves.popup_en: g3 prepares Bg2 and kingside castling.
moves.popup:
g3！飞象格准备！
准备Bg2+O-O

moves.popup_en: ...Nf6 develops a knight.
moves.popup: Nf6 黑方发展

moves.popup_en: Bg2 completes White's fianchetto and controls the long diagonal.
moves.popup: Bg2 飞象！龙象对角线！

moves.popup_en: ...g6 mirrors White's fianchetto setup.
moves.popup: g6 黑方也飞象！对称体系

moves.popup_en: O-O secures White's king.
moves.popup: O-O 白方入城

moves.popup_en: ...Bg7 completes Black's fianchetto.
moves.popup: Bg7 黑方龙象！

moves.popup_en: d3 stabilizes the center and prepares e4.
moves.popup: d3 巩固，准备e4

moves.popup_en: ...O-O secures Black's king.
moves.popup: O-O 黑方入城

moves.popup_en: Nbd2 supports the planned e4 advance.
moves.popup: Nbd2 马来支持e4

moves.popup_en: ...c5 counterattacks in the center.
moves.popup: c5！黑方中心反击

moves.popup_en: e4!! White opens the position. Several exchanges are now possible; consider what each one would accomplish.
moves.popup:
e4！！白方打开局面！

⭐ 兑换机会来临：
现在有多个兑换选项，怎么选？

moves.popup_en: ...dxe4 captures White's central pawn.
moves.popup: dxe4 黑方吃中心兵

moves.popup_en: dxe4 recaptures. Both sides have exchanged a pawn, opening the position and activating the fianchettoed bishops.
moves.popup:
dxe4 白方回吃

⭐ 第一个兑换：双方各吃一个兵！
局面开放，双方龙象活跃！

moves.popup_en: ...Ng4 attacks e4 and eyes a possible capture on e3.
moves.popup:
Ng4！黑马进攻！
攻击e4兵+Be3的可能

moves.popup_en: Nb3! White's knight attacks c5, targeting a weakness.
moves.popup:
Nb3！白马跳出！
攻击c5，针对弱点

moves.popup_en: ...Nc6 develops and reinforces both the center and c5.
moves.popup:
Nc6！黑方发展马
加强中心和c5守护

moves.popup_en: h3! White challenges the knight and forces it to move from g4.
moves.popup:
h3！白方驱马！
迫使Ng4离开

moves.popup_en: ...Nf6 retreats to a defensive square.
moves.popup: Nf6 黑马撤回防守格

moves.popup_en: Re1! White places a rook on the e-file to support e4 and increase pressure.
moves.popup:
Re1！车到e列！
守护e4，增加压力

moves.popup_en: ...Nd4! Black's knight occupies a strong outpost and attacks c2 and b3.
moves.popup:
Nd4！黑马跳d4！
进入强格，攻击c2+b3！

moves.popup_en: Nxd4! White exchanges off the strong knight for defensive reasons. After cxd4, the d-file opens and Black's pawn structure is disrupted.
moves.popup:
Nxd4！白方马换马！

⭐ 综合练习中的兑换时机：
白方为什么现在Nxd4？
① 消灭d4强马（防守性！）
② cxd4后d列开放
③ 黑方打破了自己的兵链结构

及时消灭对方的强格马！

moves.popup_en: ...cxd4 recaptures, leaving Black with an isolated pawn on d4. White can now target it.
moves.popup:
cxd4 黑兵回吃

⭐ 结果：d列开放！
黑方d4强兵出现——但是孤立兵！
白方可以攻击这个孤立兵

moves.popup_en: Nxd4! White captures the isolated pawn. The two exchanges each had a purpose: first remove the strong knight, then win the isolated pawn. This is the essence of timely exchanges: every trade should produce a concrete benefit.
moves.popup:
Nxd4！白马再吃！

⭐ 连环兑换分析：
白方连续兑换两次！
每次都有明确目的：
① 第一次：消灭强格马
② 第二次：吃掉孤立兵，获得材料

这是D14综合练习的精华：
步步有目的，换换有收益！
这就是真正的及时兑子！
